summary: Agent Smith is at the window when Agent Brown suggests the interrogation approach may be wrong. Smith, suppressing anger that 'isn't supposed to happen to Agents', orders the other two Agents out so he can be alone with Morpheus. Once alone, Smith removes his earphone and confesses hatred for the Matrix, calling it a 'zoo... this prison' he can no longer endure, describing being 'saturated' by its smell and fearing infection by humanity's 'stink'. He wipes sweat from Morpheus' forehead and holds it to Morpheus' nose, then grips Morpheus' head and demands the access codes to Zion, explaining that once Zion is destroyed he will no longer need to remain. He threatens Morpheus: tell him the codes or die, squeezing his fingers into Morpheus' flesh.

what_changes.before: A composed Agent interrogating a prisoner by standard procedure, hiding his 'knotting fist'.
what_changes.after: An Agent overcome by anger and disgust, confessing hatred for the Matrix and fearing he has been 'infected' by it.
what_changes.evidence: Agent Smith hides his knotting fist.  He is becoming angry.  It is something that isn't supposed to happen to Agents.

what_changes.before: Working alongside the other Agents as an interrogation team.
what_changes.after: Isolating himself from Brown and Jones to pursue a personal, unauthorized goal of escaping the Matrix.
what_changes.evidence: AGENT SMITH Leave me with him. AGENT SMITH Now! They leave and Agent Smith sits beside Morpheus.

what_changes.before: Interrogating Morpheus for information on behalf of the system.
what_changes.after: Revealing that his true aim is personal freedom, needing the codes to get inside Zion so he can leave once Zion is destroyed.
what_changes.evidence: I must get out of here, I must get free.  In this mind is the key.  My key.

what_changes.before: Attempting to extract the codes through the serum, which is failing.
what_changes.after: Threatening Morpheus with death and physically torturing him to force compliance.
what_changes.evidence: He begins squeezing, his fingers gouging into his flesh. AGENT SMITH You are going to tell me or you are going to die.

event_hint.one_line: Agent Smith, alone with Morpheus, abandons protocol and threatens him with death to extract Zion's access codes so he can escape the Matrix.

uncertain: Whether Morpheus will ultimately give Smith the codes.
What the serum was intended to do and why it is not working.
Whether Smith's fear of 'infection' is literal or metaphorical.

minds.wants: To break through to Morpheus by any means and get the Zion access codes — his only route out of the Matrix.
minds.feels: A disgust and rage that he experiences as contamination; he feels the Matrix saturating him and fears he is being permanently altered ('infected') by proximity to humanity.
minds.shows: First, clipped bureaucratic impatience toward Brown; then, once alone, a chilling 'honesty' — a confessional intimacy with Morpheus that curdles into physical torture.
minds.basis: He hides his 'knotting fist' at Brown's suggestion, then dismisses Brown and Jones ('Leave me with him. Now!'). Alone, he removes his earphone and confesses hatred for the 'zoo... this prison,' tastes Morpheus' 'stink,' wipes sweat onto Morpheus' face, then grips his head and squeezes while demanding the codes.

believes_about.belief: That Morpheus is a lock to be forced — that pain and the threat of death will pry the codes out of him, and that Morpheus' mind is simply 'the key' Smith is entitled to take.
believes_about.wrong_because: Morpheus sneers through the pain rather than breaking; he values Zion's survival over his own life, so Smith's escalation toward death only confirms the limits of coercion, not its power.

believes_about.belief: That Brown is a peer working the same job under the same rules, whose suggestion ('wrong questions') is mere procedural error Smith can suppress by rank.
believes_about.wrong_because: Brown is reading Smith's cracking composure — the shared glance with Jones before they obey suggests they sense something is wrong with Smith that Smith does not believe is visible.

believes_about.belief: That what is happening to him — anger, disgust, the fear of infection — 'isn't supposed to happen to Agents,' i.e., that he is malfunctioning rather than becoming something.
believes_about.wrong_because: He frames his rebellion as an accident of contamination, not a choice; he does not yet see that his hatred is the birth of a will separate from the system he serves.

minds.wants: To salvage a failing interrogation while gauging whether Smith is still fit to lead it.
minds.feels: Unease — he has noticed the serum isn't working and, more alarmingly, that Smith is coming apart.
minds.shows: A restrained, professional observation ('Perhaps we are asking the wrong questions'), then a silent exchange with Jones before obeying Smith's order.
minds.basis: Brown names the failing method, prompting Smith's suppressed anger; he and Jones 'look at each other' before leaving, a reaction that exceeds simple compliance.

believes_about.belief: That Smith's anger is a recoverable lapse and that the 'wrong questions' are about Morpheus, not about Smith himself.
believes_about.wrong_because: The real malfunction is Smith's, and being ordered out is Smith protecting a secret — his hatred of the Matrix — that Brown does not yet know exists.

minds.wants: To stay aligned with the team and not act against Smith without a signal from Brown.
minds.feels: Watchful suspicion — he registers that something is off but defers to Brown's read.
minds.shows: Nothing spoken; only the exchanged glance with Brown and silent departure.
minds.basis: Jones contributes no dialogue and mirrors Brown's look before they both leave on Smith's command.

believes_about.belief: That Smith is still the commanding Agent and obedience is the correct response.
believes_about.wrong_because: The glance with Brown shows he is already doubting that, even as he complies.

minds.wants: To withhold the codes and outlast the interrogation, buying time for his crew.
minds.feels: Pain and degradation, held at bay by conviction — he treats Smith's 'honesty' as further proof of the very corruption Morpheus has always named.
minds.shows: Silence under the serum, then a sneer through the pain when Smith grips and squeezes him.
minds.basis: Morpheus gives nothing under the serum and answers physical torture with a sneer rather than compliance.

believes_about.belief: That Smith is the embodiment of the system's cruelty and that his confession of hatred only confirms machines cannot endure humanity.
believes_about.wrong_because: Smith is not speaking as the system but against it — he wants to escape, a motive Morpheus has no reason to credit and which makes Smith more dangerous, not less.

believes_about.belief: That Smith will kill him if he does not talk, and that he can survive that threat without breaking.
believes_about.wrong_because: The threat is real and Smith will keep squeezing; Morpheus' survival will depend not on his own endurance but on the rescue his crew is already mounting.

connects_back: Smith's 'knotting fist' and rising anger continue the interrogation begun in the executive office (ev-025), where the serum administered by Brown was already failing.
The order to be left alone with Morpheus follows from the interrogation team's inability to break him by standard procedure.
Smith's fear of being 'infected' by humanity's stink extends his earlier monologue about humans as a virus.
The crew's simultaneous resolve to rescue Morpheus (ev-025, Neo rejecting the plan to kill him) runs parallel to Smith's escalating coercion here.
sets_up: ev-026: The crew's rescue debate is made urgent by Smith's shift from serum to lethal physical torture — Morpheus is now running out of time.
ev-028: The helicopter assault on the executive office is the direct answer to Smith being alone with a bound, tortured Morpheus.
ev-030 / ev-031: Smith's personal hatred of the Matrix and desire to escape foreshadow his later, private pursuit of Neo in the subway, separate from the other Agents.
dramatic_function: To convert the interrogation from a procedural set-piece into a character revelation: Smith's mask slips to expose a will in revolt against the very system he enforces, raising the stakes from information-extraction to existential threat and personalizing the antagonist just before the rescue.
